name: mesh-glow
title: Mesh Glow
description: Soft blurred glows over a fine grid with a calm vignette. Drifts slowly, or holds still.

props.name: animated
props.description: Lets the glows drift slowly. Off, or under reduced motion, they hold still.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Overall strength of the glows, from 0 to 1.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the layer. Place it absolutely behind your content.
